title: What is CLO-SET? (eCLOsystem)

Start creating your own design on the software, or download sample files from CONNECT marketplace. * Create your own 3D Design in [CLO](https://clo3d.com) or [Marvelous Designer](https://marvelousdesigner.com) software. * Prepare sample 3D files from [CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) mraketplace. ![BI_CLO_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776148489625) | ![3. Signature logo_Vertical_Shade\(Primary\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776100896409) | ![CONNECT BI Primary.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776149025689) ---|---|--- ### 2) Upload & Explore CLO-SET Once you have the 3D files ready, start uploading your files in [CLO-SET](https://style.clo-set.com). * ### Check out **Solutions** that meets your needs. For: * [Brands](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-brands) * [Manufacturers](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-manufacturers) * [Individuals](https://style.clo-set.com/service/solutions-individuals) * ### Check out CLO-SET **Key Features** : * [3D Workspace](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-workspace) * [3D Web Tech Pack](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#3d-web-tech-pack) * [Collaboration](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#collaboration) * [Cloud Rendering](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#cloud-rendering) * [Developer Tools](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#developer-tools) * [Retail & Commercial](https://style.clo-set.com/service/features#retail-commercial) ### 3) Start using CLO-SET * #### [CLO-SET FAQ](https://style.clo-set.com/service/contactus) * #### [Creating an Account](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190161177) * #### [CLO-SET Pricing Plan](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) _**💡 Notes**_ > **CLO software** is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, and sharing them across teams. ####

title: Group
content: # **Objective** Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. 1. What is a 'Group'? 2. Pricing Plan 3. Group Hierarchy 4. Permission 5. Company Transfer 6. Leave a Group # **Details** ### 1) What is a ‘Group’? ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 11.19.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776072787097) When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. ### ### 2) Pricing Plan ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.42.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776054299033) CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. ### 3) Group Hierarchy ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090181913) CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces [here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ### 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of [Permissions](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. ### 5) Company Transfer * Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776081893657) Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.03.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776071175833) 1\. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2\. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3\. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. * * Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Premium Plan. ### 6) Leave a Group * Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. * Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. * Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090704025) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776105889177) * Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106032153) * Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776082826265) * Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access. ### 🔔 Policy Update (2026.01.27) : Group Activation for New Users Joining via Invite or Share **New users** who sign up for CLO-SET **via a Group invitation or shared content** will have their personal Group **deactivated by default**. If needed, users can activate their own Group by selecting **Create My Group** from the Group Switcher. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600755328793) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54606352390041)
content_description: This webpage aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the CLO-SET Group structure, including its hierarchy, permissions, pricing plans, and collaboration features, to facilitate effective teamwork within the platform.

title: Workroom View
content:
# **Objective** Learn how to navigate CLO-SET Dashboard and utilize your Workroom Space ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777997706265) 1. Menus (Left Pane) 2. Space (Room View) 3. Comment, Share (Right Pane) 4. Content Interaction & Movement # **Details** ### 1) Menus (Left Pane) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777975520921) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 3.15.16 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778005716249) ---|--- **1\. Group Name** : See which Group you're currently in. To switch the Group, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group's name. The Blue Crown indicates that you are the Group Admin. **2\. Menu Tab** * Browse: View the space [hierarchy](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) and navigate to the desired Space * Workspace: View all Spaces by level. (ex. Click on 'Companies' to view all Company Space you have access to) * Console: View [Admin Console](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721) for usage data, billing, and developer page. * [Favorites](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): View all Spaces and Contents you've marked as Favorite * [Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents using everyday words or an image. ### 2) Space (Room View) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM copy2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777990603289) **3\. Space Info** * Upload: Upload a new Content in current Workroom * Create: Create a sub-Space * Notifications: Turn notifications on/off for current Space * [Favorite](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153): Mark/unmark the Space as Favorite * Navigation: Shows the hierarchy of the Space you are in **4.**[**Line Sheet**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289)** & **[**Data Intelligence**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303278347545) **5\. Space Name** : Name of the Space you are in (Brand | Workroom) **6.**[**Search Bar**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161): Search Contents within the Space **7.**[**Filter**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Filter the Contents you want to view ### 3)Comment, Share (Right Pane) ![Screenshot 2023-11-10 at 1.54.49 PM3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777998489625) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777990897561) #### **Share to People** * [**Invite/Share**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303179603481): Invite or share with teammates * Invite: for Company/Brand * Share: for Workroom/Content * **Share with Link:** Turning this option on will convert the Space to public status. Be ware of the security implications when sharing with link. * **Accessible People** : View the list of teammates with access to this Space. This may include those with access to higher-level Spaces. For example, anyone with access to a Brand will be able to view all Workroom within the Brand. ### **📝** Share with Link Policy update Update (December 2025) The **Enable Download** option has been updated. * **Share with Link remains available** , and **guests can still view content** as before. * **Downloads are limited to group members only**. * Even if **Enable Download** is enabled, **non–group members can view content but cannot download.** #### **Workroom Comment** * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697). Please follow the hyperlink to view detailed Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777999005209) ### 4)Content Interaction & Movement #### 4-1) Selection Interaction (Single Click / Double Click) CLO-SET separates **item selection** and **page navigation** to prevent unintended actions. * **Single click** → Select item * **Double click** → Open item and navigate to its page ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864050585) _**💡 Notes**_ > In the **Workroom** , a single click also allows you to **preview key content information** without opening the content page, making it easier to review details while browsing multiple contents.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600716195865) #### 4-2) Basic Selection Behavior #### Single Selection **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x2 | Double click on an item: opens the item ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)x1 | Single click on an item: selects the item * Previously selected item will be deselected **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)**x1 | Single click on empty space: deselects all items * Applied to **all areas except Assortment, Dashboard, and Visual Board** #### #### Multi Selection (Workroom only) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880017433) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880016025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** **📝 Note** 1. **Context Menu** * The (…) button is disabled even when an item is selected. * Even if multiple items were previously selected, the selection will be cleared and only one item will remain selected. 2. **Popover Menu** * If a Workroom is included in the selection list, all actions except _deselect_ will be disabled. #### 4-3) Drag&Drop Move for Selected Contents Once contents are selected, they can be moved more efficiently using **drag &drop** interactions. #### #### Drag into a Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** * The contents will be moved to the target location ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393880019609) #### #### Drag via Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393864062361)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive guide for users to effectively navigate the CLO-SET Dashboard and make the most of their Workroom Space.

title: Assortment
content: # **Objective** ![Icon Pack \(6\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778011371673) | 'Assortment' is a Space level for assortment planning & final review. You can also create Virtual Showroom as well as Mix & Match within Assortment. ---|--- 1. Create Assortment / Add Contents 2. Viewing Modes 3. Excel Download 4. Virtual Showroom 5. Mix & Match 6. Assortment Comment 7. 7) Colorway Version Update from Configurator # **Details** ### 1) Create Assortment / Add Contents #### ✔️ Create Assortment #### ![Screenshot 2023-08-17 at 2.44.39 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778011521433) | #### ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778011870617) | ![assortment.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778027003545) ---|---|--- * **Create Assortment in Season page** 1\. Click ![blobid0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778020091033) icon from the 'Season' Space. 2\. Enter Assortment name and click 'CONFIRM' button. * **Add Style to Assortment in Workroom page** 1\. Put the mouse cursor on the desired Style and click the![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778037862297)icon. 2\. Click 'Add to Assortment'. * User must be Admin or Collaborator to add Content to Assortment. * **Add Style to Assortment in Assortment page** 1\. Click ![blobid1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778020508569) icon and select the desired style to add into Assortment. 2\. Select the desired style from EXPLORER or add the style you recently worked on from RECENT. ### 2) Viewing Modes #### ✔️ Viewer Mode Drop Down Menu Quickly switch the viewer option between 2D, 3D, and Render. **Hover over the style** in Assortment Room, and you will see a drop-down menu on the upper right corner. Click to switch viewer modes! ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778027716377) ✔️ By Viewer Mode **2D** | **3D** | **Render** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038351641) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038486681) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778021096345) *When viewing in Render mode, selecting a colorway OUTSIDE the viewer will NOT be reflected. *Colorway list is from the original Zprj file. New colorway added from CLO-SET Configurator will not show. To add new colorways, upload a new Zprj file, and move the garment to Assortment room. #### ✔️ Synchronized Camera in Assortment ‘Synchronized Camera’ in Assortment, by allowing users to add multiple Contents in Assortment and view them at the same time with the customized multiview. 1. Select the desired 3D contents and activate 3D Viewers by clicking the 'Viewer' button in the 3D window. 2. When the 3D viewer has been activated, turn on the Synchronized Camera mode by clicking the 'Synchronized' button on the top of the 3D contents. 3. Now, you can review and control multiple 3D contents with the customized multiview at the same time. ※ Note: In accordance with the release of ‘Synchronized Camera’, ‘My bag’ Function will discontinue its service and be replaced from October 5, 2021. #### ✔️ Colorway Show&Hide **Show/Hide** button is available at the bottom of the content section. Select any items you wish to hide, then enable the _**Show Hidden Colorway**_**toggle** at the top to view the content while excluding the hidden items. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950257252889) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950257258521) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52950228676249) **Show & Hide visibility control** is also available in **Content Mode** within the Assortment Room. Contents marked as hidden in Content Mode are excluded from the **Excel linesheet.** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600626487321) ### ### 3) Excel Download You may utilize [Excel Download](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303209763865) ( ![blobid2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778028428057)) to export the info of Contents within the Assortment. ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778038942105) ### 4) Virtual Showroom You may create a [Virtual Showroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303178555801) using the 3D Contents within your Assortment. Please follow the link to find detailed guidelines on how to set up your Virtual Showroom. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 1.15.34 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778014153881) ### 5) Simple Mix & Match [Mix & Match](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303205588377) your Contents to review the full style. You can try mixing up the combination to see which designs go well together. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 1.20.11 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778014436121) ### 6) Assortment Comment * Commenting is available at the Assortment level. * Please follow the [hyperlink](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171263641) for more details including Permissions. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778039817497) ### 7) Colorway Version Update from Configurator Colorways created in the **Configurator** are displayed in the **Assortment Room**. When a newer version is available, a **red dot indicator** appears next to the content, allowing Editors (or higher) to update to the latest version, while Viewers can see the indicator without access to the update action. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600635531801) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600626489625)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to effectively plan, review, and manage their assortments, utilizing features such as virtual showrooms and mix & match capabilities.

title: Annotation
content: # **Objective** Create an Annotation for a detailed feedback. 1. Create/Edit Annotation 2. Annotation Shortcut 3. Download Annotations in PDF 4. Send Annotation by email 5. Copy Annotation to new Version # **Details** ### 1) Create Annotation To add an Annotation, click ![Icon Pack \(7\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417243673) icon in the upper right corner of 3D Viewer in Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366812407193) **1) Select a Version:** Annotation can be created on each Version. Select the desired Version first, and click on 'Annotation' icon ![Icon Pack \(7\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417243673) at the top-right corner of the 3D Viewer. **2) Create Annotation:** Use the toolbar on the right to create an Annotation. Once you're done, click 'Complete'. You will see a new Annotation has been created on the far right pane. * Annotation Toolbar ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778432888217) | Comment (T) | Click within the 3D viewer, write a comment, and click ‘POST’. Double-click to edit. Shortcuts: **Bold (Ctrl + B)** / _Italic (Ctrl + I)_ /Underline (Ctrl + U) ---|---|--- Image (I) | You can attach an image file as annotation. Select (V) | You can change the position of comment or drawing. Pencil (B) Line (L) Pen (P) Arrow (A) Arc (C) Rentangle (R) | Create drawing and basic figures. Line Color (O) Line Width (W) | You can set drawing color and thickness. ### 2) Annotation Shortcut All Functions | Copy | Ctrl + C ---|---|--- Paste | Ctrl + V Flip Horizontally | Shift + H Flip Vertically | Shift + V ![Annotation.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417947417) ### 3) Download Annotation in PDF ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 6.29.00 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778418213785) Click on the Annotation icon on your right pane to view the list of Annotations. Next to each Annotation, you may click on ••• icon to download the PDF. To download a PDF including all Annotations, click on 'PDF' button at the top right corner. ### 4) Send Annotation by email ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366775647001)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366812416793) When you click the **Email** button next to the **PDF Download** button, you can send the annotation notification immediately. Please enter the recipient’s email address and click **Send**. The email will include a **content download button** , which will remain valid for **up to two weeks** after the email is sent. ### ### 5) Copy Annotation to new Version ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.17.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778433888921) | ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.17.49 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778434264473) | ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 6.36.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778419247129) ---|---|--- * From the latest version, click on 'Annotation' button on the right pane * Click ''Get previous version of the Annotation' button * Select the Annotations you'd like to bring to the new Version
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for users to create, edit, download, and share annotations, enhancing their feedback experience on various versions of content within the 3D Viewer.

title: Account Deletion & Subscription Cancellation
content:
**Q1 : How do I delete my account?** **A1 : There are two ways to delete your CLO-SET account.** You can either wait until your current subscription expires and then delete your account, or choose to cancel your subscription immediately and delete your account right away. **Note:** Once your account is deleted, all data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered. * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to delete account on CLO-SET. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## **Details** #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1. Visit “My Page” from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) to start the account deletion process. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461458073) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "My Page". ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454111769) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454112281) > 💡 **Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller
> > on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete
> > the account directly. Please click **"Contact US"** button for further assistance. ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461460761) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. > 💡 **Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active only **after the end date**. #### ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454119193) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ > 💡 **Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing. ![mceclip7.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461463705) 2\. title: Didn’t receive the verification email during sign-up?
content: **Q1: I am not receiving the verification email. What should I do?** **A1:** Double check the email address typed in. Make sure you do not have typos. **A2:** If you are using your company email, please contact your IT team for any firewall setups. The verification email may be blocked from your company's email server settings, even before reaching your spam inbox. **A3:** If you are still experiencing the issue, please [submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) for a manual verification process. **A4: Student Email** \- Some school domains block external emails. Please check if your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com) **A5: Gmail Account -** Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam. Go to your spam folder and open the email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com). Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO-SET emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior. **Note :** Even if your email address has not been verified yet, you can still log in to CLO-SET. After logging in, you can complete the email verification process at any time again. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138028055193) * * * **Q2: I signed up using a Google account and did not see an email verification step. Is this an issue?** **A1:** No, this is not an issue. If you sign up using a Google account, your email address is automatically verified, so no additional email verification step is required. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138106505369)
content_description: This web page provides guidance on troubleshooting issues related to email verification for users, including steps to resolve common problems and clarification for Google account sign-ups.

title: How do I change my email address?
content: ## **Q1 : How can I change my email address?** **A1 :** Go to **My Page** and click **Change Email** to update your email address. * * * **Q2 : I see a message saying that my email cannot be changed. Why is this happening?** **A2 :** There may be several reasons why you are unable to change your email address. Your issue may fall under one of the cases below. 1. **Email address already in use** 2. **Unable to change email** 3. **Account region mismatch** (*CLO / CLO-SET only) 4. **Email change will affect the plan type** (*CLO only) For detailed explanations and step-by-step solutions, please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) . * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. [Change Email vs. Email Switching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3) 2. [Ground Rules for Change Email](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#01J14B22H7ABR174MHJYQN61F6) 3. [Change Email Guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN98R7YZPTP1RMBQ3QSFP) * General Flow * Confirm License Info * Troubleshooting 4. [Change Email Implications](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | **VS** | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774805401) | ![emai switch.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773992217) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the [Change Email Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577). * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773993625) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773994393) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773995545) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773997977) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774811289)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774003737)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004121)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004377) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774006937) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577)' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for instructions. Note : #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * Additionally, please review what to consider when changing emails for each product: [CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CONNECT](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ### [CLO] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. ### [Marvelous Designer] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. ### [CLO-SET / CONNECT] * **Billing Email Matching** The registered payment information on Stripe will NOT be updated automatically. To change the email address of your Stripe account, please visit Stripe (<https://stripe.com/>). * **Account Data** Users can continue accessing the Groups and uploaded files they have permission to. Please note that your account name will not be updated. To change your account name, please visit [https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount.](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [**Troubleshooting Guide**](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address in CLO-SET, along with troubleshooting tips and important implications to consider before making the change.

What is Visual Board? 2. User Scenario 3. Create 4. Edit Mode * Utilizing 3D Assets * Edit Mode UI 5. Invite & Share 6. Export to PDF 7. Permission & Notification 8. Shortcut keys # **Details** ### **1) What is Visual Board?** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774771787033) Visual Board is a creation tool for showcasing your design using the 3D assets in CLO-SET. Users can now create Lookbooks or Moodboards with the 3D assets. * Create Lookbook, Moodboard, or Presentation with your Assets * Collaborate with your team online * Drag & Drop 3D assets to add 2D Images with a click ### 2) User Scenario ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774772003481) ### 3) Create Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor * From your dashboard, click on 'Workspace' > 'Visual Board' * Click '+' to create a new Visual Board * Enter the title and description, then click 'Create' * [Please Note] Only the creator of the Board & Group Admin will have access to the Board. Invite new members as Editors to the Board for collaboration. * Editors of the Group will NOT be automatically added to the Board. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774767636505) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774767800345) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774814678297) ---|---|--- ### 4) Edit Mode Permission: Group Admin, Board Creator, Board Editor (directly shared from Board's Share tab) * Start editing the Board. You may use ALL assets you have access to within the Group. * Please note: only 1 user can edit the Board at a time. While 1 user is editing, others can view Slide Show or Comments. Slide Show will be based on the last saved version. * Make sure to click 'Save' once the work is complete. * Click 'Share' ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) to add Board Editors to grant edit access. * Group members will NOT be automatically added. You must add the user as Editor to each Board for collaboration. * [Important] When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ### [Utilizing 3D Assets] * To add your Contents/Files on the board, start dragging & dropping the Content from the right pane to the slide. When adding the Content, you have an option to embed a link to 3D viewer, Content Page, or Customer URL. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774761264025) 1. 1. **Add Images** : Select view(s) to add. * Zprj/Zpac files: Select from Thumbnail, Front, Left, Right, and Back view. * Other file types: Add Thumbnail image. 2. **Link (URL)** : Create hyperlink to the 3D Viewer, Content Page, or Custom URL to the image. 3. **Include Name & Colorway Name**: Insert the Content Name or Colorway Name as a text object ### [Colorway Options] * Select 'By Colorway' to add Images of different Colorways. ![Screenshot 2024-04-04 at 3.44.25 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774761405849) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774800280601) * * By Content: displays [Default Colorway](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129) (last selected when saved in CLO software). * By Colorway: displays selected Colorway. * [Thumbnail](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191375129): customizable on the original Content Page. ### [Edit Mode UI] ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785382425) 1. **Title** : Title of the Board. Changes will not be saved **3\. Share** * Edit Permission is unique for each Board. You must have Editor permission to the specific Board to make changes. Group Admin can access/edit/delete all Boards as a default. * Creator of the Board automatically has Editor permission to the Board * Add other members to the Board as Editors to collaborate. * Group members will NOT be automatically granted permission to edit the Board. Edit Toolbar:** add or edit components on/to your slide **Edit Toolbar** | **Bubble Toolbar** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819873689) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785684377) > 💡 Notes: Drawing Curved Line

Available Color Palettes** * please note: custom palettes uploaded as color preset are not yet supported in Visual Board **Picker** | **PANTONE** | **coloro** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774785839129) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774762696089) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774786337049) **6-2. Slide Background / Undo & Redo** * Background: Select the background color of each slide * Undo & Redo the edit action **7\. Search & Filter**: find the Asset within the Group, or select the Space to find the Content. **8\. Asset List** : Drag & Drop the Asset to the Board to add an Image. You can only use Assets you have permission to. **💡 Tips** **1\. Change Order** : Select the object(s) and right click to change the order. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774801962905) * **Single Select** : change the order of a single object. * Bring to front: bring the object to the very front of the slide * Bring forward: bring the object to move forward by 1 layer * Send to back: bring the object to the very back of the slide (excluding background) * Send backward: bring the object to move back by 1 layer * **Multi Select** : change the order of multiple objects together. Order among the selected objects will remain. * Bring to front: bring the objects selected the very front of the slide as a group * Send to back: bring the objects selected to the very back of the slide as a group (excluding background) **2\. Rotate & Flip **: All objects transformation “Rotate & Flip” available *** image, drawing (by pencil), line, shape, text (rotate only)** ![Group 137.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033270018841) * Free Rotate (15 degree by each pitch) by Handle UI with a Selected Object * Multi select “rotate & flip” available![06 - Object Rotation.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48033297757465) **3\. Pen tool** : allows to draw precise lines and curves for more detailed visual expression * Draw both **straight lines and curves** using a single Pen Tool * Create more **precise and flexible shapes** for visual annotations and concept sketches * Edit shapes by adjusting points and curves for finer control ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188819888025) **[Pen tool Key Features]** **1\. Flexible Shape Creation** 1. Draw straight lines by clicking points with Left Mouse Button (LMB) 2. Create curves by clicking, holding, and dragging with LMB 3. Close shapes to create filled areas **2\. Edit Mode** 1. **Enter/Exit** : Double-click (LMB) on any shape to enter Edit Mode 2. **Select and Move Points** : Click (LMB) to select and reposition individual anchor points 3. **Bezier Handle Editing** : Adjust curve handles (LMB) for precise curvature control 4. **Change Point Type** : Ctrl + LMB to toggle between corner and curve points macOS: `Command + LMB` Windows: `Ctrl + LMB` 5. **Decouple Bezier Handles** : Alt + LMB for independent handle control (aligning them pairs them again) macOS: `Option + LMB` Windows: `Alt + LMB` 6. **Move Segments** : Select and drag segments (highlighted by two points) to adjust shapes 7. **Add Points** : Click the guide point in the middle of any segment 8. **Remove Points** : Select a point and press `Delete / Backspace` 9. **Multi-Select** : `Shift + LMB` to select multiple points simultaneously 10. **Delete Shape** : Select all points (or all except one) and press Backspace macOS: `Delete` Windows: `Backspace` ### 4) Invite & Share (Slide Show Mode) * **Add Editor** (Add Board Editor for collaboration) * Click the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner to add Board Editors * Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. * Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. * [Important]: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774830525337) * **Share & Publish** (Share the slide show with external users) * From Slide Show mode, click on the 'Share' button ![share.svg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774799741337) at the top-right corner * **Restricted** : Only you and Can Edit member can access the slide show with link * **Publish** : Anyone with link can view the slide show ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774770667289) ### 6) Export to PDF ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774775546905) On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774817739033) * Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) * All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) ### 7) Permission & Notification * Permission to Visual Board * Please note: Group members are NOT automatically granted access to all Boards. You must be added as an Editor to each Board to view/make changes to unpublished Boards. ![visualboardpermission.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45774802983577) * Notification * Manage notifications regarding Visual Board on [My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) * Notification sent to: Group Admin, Board Creator, and Board Editors (anyone added to each Board with 'Can Edit' permission) ### 8) Shortcut Keys **Key** | **Details** ---|--- Ctrl/Command + z Ctrl/Command + y | Undo Redo Ctrl/Command + a | Select all objects Shift + h Shift + v | Flip (horizontal) Flip (vertical) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54188804737305) v i t b l p c | Select Tool Image Tool Text Tool Pencil Tool Line Tool Pen Tool Shapes Tool [ Ctrl/Command + [ ] Ctrl/Command + ] | Bring to front Bring forward Send to back Send backward

However, _Depth Peeling_ is **not applied** in the following cases: * When displaying **thumbnails** in the Workroom **[D****isplaying****thumbnails****in the Workroom****]** → A _ppears slightly translucent in the workroom thumbnail._ ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52158899977113) Except for this cases, depth peeling in the 3D Viewer has been improved to ensure more consistent and reliable transparency rendering, even while rotating, panning, or zooming the camera. (updated 25.12) **![viewerCameraManipulationBeforeAfter.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53611678505625)** ### ### What’s Improved * Transparent materials are now displayed **consistently** , even while rotating, panning, or zooming the camera * The viewer no longer changes how transparency appears during camera movement ### What to Expect * No more **flickering** or**“weird” transparency** while moving the camera * More **accurate and stable 3D visuals** throughout your workflow

content: Invite your team members, or share your work to your partners. Understand the difference and learn how to start collaborating. # **Objective** 1. Invite vs. Share 2. Invite 3. Share 4. Accessible People 5. Public Content 6. Permission Management # **Details** ### 1) Invite vs. Share There are 4 Permission Level in CLO-SET. title: AI Studio - Graphic Generator
content: # **Objective** ### Understand how to use the **AI Studio - Graphic Generator** on CLO-SET. 1. ##### What is AI STUIDO - Graphic Generator 2. ##### How to Use the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) What is AI Studio - Graphic Generator? AI Studio – Graphic Generator generates customizable graphic images from text-based prompts. By simply typing in keywords (or uploading image), you can create unique graphics that can be applied directly to your 3D garments and patterns. #### **[Generate]** 1. You can choose either the **Text** or **Image** option in the AI Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784829209) 2. Set options, enter prompts (or upload image), and click the Generate button.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777066777) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784841113) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image.**This option is not available for the Pop Art type.** **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784844825)** **Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. #### **[Apply]** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → If you apply it, the result will be uploaded as a **new version**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777077785) ##### **📝Note:** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. ### 2) Using the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET 1. Upload content from AI Studio Click the __**New**__**** button in the workroom and select __**Upload from AI Studio**__. Image content can be generated instantly using the**Graphic Generator** within the workroom space. ![Group 1050.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784853273) 2. You may leave the page while the downloading is in process.
